decisions.rationale: Valid, confirmed by reading e838bbe7: task5PredictsTheProblemBodyOfTheFix only requires non-blank PREDICTED_TITLE and PREDICTED_DETAIL and a 400 problem+json body with string title and detail, so it never compares the body with the prediction; a green run prints nothing, and README line 85 asks the learner to compare values the lab never shows and to 'correct the constant' with no trigger, in non-learner wording ('independent response contract', 'oracle'). The critic's wrong-prediction run (12/12, no output) was not repeated by the reconciler; the reading is sufficient. Fix lands in loop 7 under supervisor decision validation-loop7-o3: rewrite line 85 in learner-facing words that state the test passes whatever was predicted, and give the learner a way to inspect the real title and detail after the fix (for example a print of the step-1 result, naming any import it needs, since the file says its imports are already present) without disclosing the values before step 2. This stays consistent with decision validation-final-byte-proof: problemdetail#o2 remains unclaimed and module.json already records that gap.

Valid and high: bean-validation-on-requests#o3 is claimed in lab.json at e838bbe7 (it is not claimed on origin/main 1814ba7d, so this branch introduced the claim) and no shipped check requires the constraint. Reconciler runs on lab bytes of e838bbe7 (git-archive copies, JDK 25.0.5+8, Maven 3.9.16, mvn -q -o test offline against a copied local repository): the private completed solution passes 12/12; the same solution with the id constraint removed and a hand-written ResponseStatusException(BAD_REQUEST, reason) for ids below 1 also passes 12/12, because Task 6's built-in problem details render it as a 400 problem+json with a detail. The critics' reason-less, ErrorResponseException and @Min(1) variants were not repeated. Remedy verified by the reconciler in scratch copies: asserting in task5RejectsANonPositiveIdWith400 that the MockMvc result's resolved exception for GET /bookings/0 is HandlerMethodValidationException keeps the solution at 12/12 and makes the hand-written mutant fail task5RejectsANonPositiveIdWith400 with the actual type ResponseStatusException. It reads runtime behaviour, not declarations or source, and discloses neither predicted value. Fix lands in loop 7 under supervisor decision validation-loop7-o3; this finding stays open in T25 until a current loop-7 education recheck marks it resolved.

Valid, confirmed by reading e838bbe7: README line 193 still names a declaring-class cause that ErrorSliceTest no longer checks (assertSliceWithFake only checks the absent ApplicationAvailability bean, non-mock fakes and byId(1L) throwing), and line 191 bolds 'the call to create must still be recorded' while the shipped WebLayerTest message reads 'the controller's create call with the posted booking must remain recorded'. Part (3) also holds by reading: the context-mock check in task8ShowsThatAPlainMockIsOnlyCalledWhenYouPassItIn is an unlabelled verifyNoInteractions, whose Mockito text the line 191 row attributes to a missing verify. Low; the rows still point at the right tasks. Fix lands in loop 7 under the 'repair stale Troubleshooting rows' item of decision validation-loop7-o3, and should cover all three parts.

Valid as a fact and accepted as an out-of-scope main-era claim, not fixed in this delivery. Reconciler check: git show origin/main (1814ba7d) lab.json already claims bean-validation-on-requests#o2, global-error-handling#o3 and standard-error-responses-with-problemdetail#o1; grep of the lab at e838bbe7 finds no ProblemDetail type or extra property, no server-side logging and no learner prediction of failing fields, so each is only half executed, and module.json at HEAD has a partial-coverage note only for problemdetail#o2. This branch did not add these claims; per supervisor decision validation-loop7-o3 this delivery does not repair unrelated main-era objectives, so the inconsistency with the problemdetail#o2 standard stays open for a later module branch (record partial coverage in module.json sourceCoverageNotes or unclaim). Low, so it does not block.

Valid. Reconciler runs on lab bytes of e838bbe7 (git-archive copies, JDK 25.0.5+8, Maven 3.9.16, mvn -q -o test offline against a copied local repository): the private completed solution with ErrorSliceTest switched to a full @SpringBootTest with MockMvc auto-configuration, spring.autoconfigure.exclude of org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.availability.ApplicationAvailabilityAutoConfiguration and bean-definition overriding, the nested fake registered under the real service's bean name, passes 12/12. This is a deliberate edit aimed at the check, not a plausible learner route, and any behavioural marker can be defeated by editing the context to match it, so the check stays as is. Acknowledged residual: loop 7 states it accurately in README (line 123 sentence on the slice claim) and in lab-run.json testScope, under supervisor decision validation-loop7-o3; no test change.

Valid and the same stale Troubleshooting rows as cg-education-validation-013 (lines 191 and 193), confirmed by reading e838bbe7. Low. Fix lands in loop 7 under decision validation-loop7-o3: line 193 names the current causes (full application context, a Mockito mock, a fake that finds booking 1) and line 191 quotes the current shipped message.

Valid, confirmed by reading e838bbe7: expected/test-summary.txt line 21 says the fixed GET /bookings/0 answers 'with the title and detail you predicted', but no test compares the body with the prediction, so a learner with a wrong prediction sees a mismatch after a green run. Low. Fix lands in loop 7 under decision validation-loop7-o3: say the body is a 400 problem+json with a title and a detail to compare with the Task 5 prediction.

Valid and the same three objectives as cg-education-validation-014. Accepted as out-of-scope main-era claims, not fixed in this delivery: origin/main (1814ba7d) lab.json already claims bean-validation-on-requests#o2, global-error-handling#o3 and standard-error-responses-with-problemdetail#o1, the lab at e838bbe7 executes only part of each, and module.json records no partial coverage for them. Per supervisor decision validation-loop7-o3 this delivery does not repair unrelated main-era objectives; a later module branch should record them in module.json sourceCoverageNotes or unclaim them. Low, so it does not block.

Valid and reopened. The earlier reconciliation (coverage-gap-reconciliation.json) accepted it as fixed by a reflection check on the byId id parameter; that check was removed in bff3db3c, so that 'fixed' statement no longer holds and this decision supersedes it. Same defect as cg-education-validation-012 and verified by the same reconciler runs (hand-written ResponseStatusException with a reason passes 12/12 at e838bbe7). The claim that a hand-written check fails BugReportTest holds only for the reason-less variant and must not be repeated in the lab-run record or proof notes. Fix lands in loop 7 under supervisor decision validation-loop7-o3: the resolved-exception type assertion (HandlerMethodValidationException) in task5RejectsANonPositiveIdWith400, which the reconciler verified keeps the solution green and fails the hand-written mutant.

Valid as a fact and accepted again as a documented low residual, not fixed in loop 7. Reconciler runs on lab bytes of e838bbe7 (git-archive copies, JDK 25.0.5+8, Maven 3.9.16, mvn -q -o test offline against a copied local repository): the private completed solution with create stubbed by an any() matcher and Mockito.ignoreStubs in place of the create verify, in both Task 8 tests, passes 12/12. Not a must-fix: ignoreStubs is an advanced API that nothing in the README, the S10 pages or the hints points to, it is not a plausible misconception about @MockitoBean, and every learner-facing outcome holds on the intended path; WebLayerTest's checks are unchanged in kind since the first acceptance. The residual is documented only in the critic reports and the reconciliations, not in learner-facing text; README line 140 'any call on the mock is unverified' overstates only against this deliberate bypass. Optional follow-up for the next edit of this lab: a shipped check that the mocks carry no stubbing of create.
